svg.text: OLEANDER Modeling Worker v0.13 — G1 R2 Visual Evidence
Deterministic projection manifest is generated from G1_R2_RELATION_CORRECTION + g1_r2_core. Runtime shaded views were inspected in perspective/top/side/front before this receipt.
01 — Palm volume is the first reading; the recessed interface basin is secondary and remains subordinate.
02 — Thumb-side breadth is visibly larger than the opposite side without splitting the global volume.
03 — Longitudinal terminations are rounded handheld wraps rather than the rejected R1 symmetric pointed-lens reading.
04 — The interface basin has one explicit semantic boundary and one recessed core; its C2 transition remains continuous.
05 — G1-R2-R1 thumb revision increases the intended side relation while leaving opposite-side ownership unchanged.
BASE_TOP — X/Y relationship and asymmetry reading
BASE_SIDE — X/Z palm / basin / return hierarchy
BASE_FRONT — Y/Z asymmetry and interface transition
R1_THUMB_REV_PERSPECTIVE — controlled upstream relation revision comparison
L/W/H = 0.1900 / 0.08076 / 0.10482 m; interface depth = 0.0120 m; asymmetry probe = 0.01023 m.
Broad fairness = 2.813° longitudinal / 4.184° circumferential; interface boundary continuity < 0.24°.
This is benchmark visual evidence, not ergonomic validation, final product styling, Class-A, engineering CAD or manufacturing approval.
Surface Source remains WORKING_SOURCE. Visual evidence cannot authorize Candidate Authority by itself.
